ratchet.$comment: Counts of registered tests still missing metadata. These numbers may only decrease. Both reached zero when every leaf test moved to mne_add_test() (T1.2/T1.3), which now also refuses to configure a test without them.

$conditional_comment: Tests whose add_test() sits behind an early return(), so they vanish from CTest whenever the guard fires. Each needs a reason naming the guard. This list is a defect inventory, not an approved pattern, and is empty since T1.3: a missing target is declared with mne_add_test(... REQUIRES_TARGETS ...), which registers a visible skip before any return().

$quarantine_schema.$comment: Required shape of every entry in 'quarantine'. A quarantined test must name an owner, an issue, an expiry date, and a reason; an expired entry fails validation. Quarantine is the only sanctioned way to keep a failing test in the tree, because CI does not retry.
$quarantine_schema.reason: why the test cannot simply be fixed now
